# Calendar Email Reminders Solution Design
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

## Data

`calendar_events` stores three boolean reminder settings with true defaults. `calendar_event_reminder_deliveries` stores one idempotent delivery record per event, user, and reminder offset, including schedule time, status, attempts, queue time, sent time, and the last failure.

## Delivery

`calendar:send-reminders` runs every minute. It finds future events within the largest reminder window, resolves active approved verified participant and administrator recipients, creates delivery records, and queues `SendCalendarEventReminder` jobs. The job validates the current event schedule and access state before sending `CalendarEventReminderNotification` through the configured mail transport.

## Change Handling

Future deliveries use the current event start time. A stale queued job is returned to pending when the event time or reminder setting changes. Deleted events cannot send because their delivery records cascade and the job requires the event record.

## Environment Gate

Local development supports the database queue and Mailpit configuration. Staging and production capabilities remain unverified. A persistent queue worker, one-minute scheduler, dependable mail transport, sender identity, failed-job handling, and monitoring are required before participant use.
